class_order: source canonical class_index; original categoryID0 valid, only padding=-1
teacher: Existing per-class maximum same-class GT IoU, IoU>=.5 retained else0; no new GT and no onehot matching; multiple positives retained
support: Original actual support and query-valid mask, never positive-label-derived
eligible: query_valid and supported_count>=2 and at least one supported y>0 and one supported y==0
loss: sum_{p:y_p>0,a_p=1} y_p * sum_{n:y_n=0,a_n=1} softplus(-(delta_p-delta_n)) / (sum_positive y_p * number_supported_zero)
no_positive_or_no_zero: Skip conditional loss, never replace by uniform labels; all remain in full regularizer population

weighting.conditional: equal source -> equal eligible source images -> equal eligible proposals
weighting.regularizer: equal source -> equal all source images -> equal all proposals

gate_context.precision: CPU Float64 from original unpermuted canonical supported B values, finally cast Float32

permutation.target: Whole M8..11 row vectors within the same proposal truly supported canonical class set; G/availability/padding/class labels unchanged
permutation.validation_test: seed+fold_or_case+canonical proposal key; fixed no epoch
permutation.algorithm: Uniform permutation without replacement, including possible fixed points; independent label-free RNG stream, never keyed by y/GT/loss/test AP
